result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-formed. The carousel and bottom-cut items are expected scroll behavior and are not reported. One clear defect is the truncated/garbled restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the Popular list, which is not caused by scrolling. There are also a few minor styling and accessibility concerns.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is rendered incorrectly. The final letter looks clipped and renders as 'Rameı', as if the text is cut off or a glyph is broken. This card is a full-width vertical list item with plenty of horizontal space, so the cut-off is not scroll behavior.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text container's width, padding, or overflow and the font rendering so the full name 'Tokumaru Ramen' displays. Verify the font has all needed glyphs.

issues.description: The duration pill ('15–25 min') overlaps the plate image and is tightly placed. The secondary gray text (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') is light and small, so its contrast on white is low.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 and increase the font size slightly.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the food image cards is white on a semi-transparent dark circle. On the pizza card the circle blends into the busy image, which weakens the button's visibility.
issues.suggestion: Use a more opaque or solid background for the favorite button so it stays visible on every image.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative translucent circles are cut off and overlap the right edge, and the code text sits close to them. The white text on the mid-green background also has modest contrast.
issues.suggestion: Deepen the green or reduce the decorative overlay so the promo text has stronger contrast.
